# Quiet Treasury

> A NEAR DAO votes once on a plain-English mandate (parsed by a TEE model into bounded terms). A bounded agent executes it in price-floored chunks, pays contributors, returns leftovers to the DAO and anchors a verifiable settlement report on-chain. Public NEAR testnet; no mainnet funds were moved.

This file is a map, not evidence. Verify with the commands below; `docs/CLAIMS.md` lists every claim with its status (VERIFIED-TESTNET, LOCAL, SIMULATED, UNVERIFIED, NOT IMPLEMENTED).

## Run
- `npm ci && npm test` : 396 unit tests (vitest), no network or keys needed
- `npm run demo` : the whole story offline (labelled simulation, ~2 s)
- `npm run verify` : independent verifier over three recorded proof bundles (13 + 21 + 16 checks, offline)
- `npm run secret-scan` : repository secret scan
- `npm run dashboard` : Next.js dashboard on :3100 (after `npm --prefix app ci`); its `/recompute` page re-derives a recorded run from public RPC in the browser
- `npm run verify:contract` and `npm run check:evidence` : network checks (deployed contract hash == committed wasm; every cited tx exists on testnet: 201/201)

## Read first
- `docs/JUDGES.md` : 5-minute path, what is proven and what is not
- `docs/TRACKS.md` : per-track proof map with a command per claim; `docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md`
- `README.md` : per-track explanation, architecture, NEAR technology map
- `docs/CLAIMS.md` : claims vs evidence
- `SECURITY.md` : what each safety layer stops and does not stop, what a stolen key or a hostile operator can and cannot do, known limits, how to report a problem
- `docs/CUSTODY.md` : OutLayer custody wallet, per-mandate policy, what the policy does and does not enforce
- `docs/OUTLAYER-FEEDBACK.md` : reproducible findings about OutLayer's API (for the sponsor)
- `docs/SEALED.md`, `docs/DEFI.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/RUNBOOK.md`, `docs/CONTRACT.md`, `docs/adr/` (decisions and what they rejected), `docs/incidents/` (what really failed), `CONTEXT.md` (vocabulary), `AGENTS.md`

## Code map
- `contracts/mandate/` : Rust mandate contract v2 (state machine, idempotent chunk records, report anchoring, trust score, NEP-297 events, versioned state, pause, two-step DAO handover); `docs/CONTRACT.md`, 36 tests
- `src/near/` : clients (Sputnik DAO, mandate contract, NEAR AI Cloud, OutLayer, Intents 1Click, near.social)
- `src/engine/` : mandate schema (zod), parser, hashing, benchmark
- `src/verify/` : independent verifier
- `worker/` : executor, guards, sqlite state, API, red team; `worker/adapters/` : Ref testnet adapter, signers (key or OutLayer custody), per-mandate policy
- `scripts/testnet/` : end-to-end runs on public testnet; `data/demo-run/` : recorded runs and proof bundles (every transaction has an explorer link)
- `app/` : dashboard

## Network
NEAR testnet. DAO `quietdao-83872.sputnikv2.testnet`, mandate contract `qtmandate2-83872.testnet` (v2; v1 `qtmandate-83872.testnet` stays on chain, its recordings are tagged `v1-recorded-runs` in git).
